title: X9R9A Ver:003 compared with the March build: Re-Size BAR Support option
configuration: Two images compared offline; no hardware involved
observations: bme ifr: the Setup form of this build has the question "Re-Size BAR Support" (id 0x0071, Setup+0x48, one byte, 0=Disabled, 1=Enabled, default 0), right after "Above 4G Decoding" (Setup+0x47). The March build (X9R9P Ver:005) has no such question.

The new field shifts the Setup variable: SR-IOV Support moves from Setup+0x48 to Setup+0x49, BME DMA Mitigation from 0x49 to 0x4a, VGA Palette Snoop from 0x4b to 0x4c, PERR# Generation from 0x4c to 0x4d and SERR# Generation from 0x4d to 0x4e.

bme compare against the March image (SHA-256 4036d26e7ff72160625fd8a1d9cc33095116d02342f7e5398f7fdb1bfb71b2a6): 828 paired modules, 645 identical, 13 identical after relocation normalization, 170 different; 2 only in the March image and 1 only in this one.
PciBus (3C1DE39F-D207-408A-AACC-731CFB7F1DD7) grows from 68576 to 69312 bytes and differs after normalization.
limits: Read from the stored forms and module bytes of one image. Whether the option works, which module implements it and whether the board hardware supports resized BARs were not examined; nothing was flashed or booted. A Setup offset recorded for the March build at or above 0x48 does not apply to this build.
